theorems.name: Submission.mcm_lp_holder_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)) (H : Ambient n ℓ → Ambient n ℓ) (p : ℝ) (ξ : Ambient n ℓ) (R τ : ℝ), 0 < n → IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ → (n : ℝ) < p → MemLp H (ENNReal.ofReal p) (μ.restrict (closedBall ξ R)) → 0 < τ → τ ≤ R → |(∫ x in closedBall ξ τ, inner ℝ (x - ξ) (H x) ∂μ) / τ ^ (n + 1)| ≤ (R ^ (p - n) * ∫ x in closedBall ξ R, ‖H x‖ ^ p ∂μ) ^ (1 / p) / R * (τ / R) ^ (-(n : ℝ) / p) * (1 + μ.real (closedBall ξ τ) / τ ^ n)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
